text:
Which statement about the disposal of waste plastics is correct?
A
They are put in landfill sites, where they quickly decompose.
B
They are burned to produce non-toxic products.
C
They accumulate in oceans, where they are harmful to aquatic life.
D
They are dissolved in water and pumped into the sea.

options.label: A
options.text: They are put in landfill sites, where they quickly decompose.

options.label: B
options.text: They are burned to produce non-toxic products.

options.label: C
options.text: They accumulate in oceans, where they are harmful to aquatic life.

options.label: D
options.text: They are dissolved in water and pumped into the sea.
